name: Kyamba Court Motel
description:
Set along Mooloolah River, this relaxed, family-run motel is a 10-minute walk from both the Sea Life Sunshine Coast Aquarium and Mooloolaba Beach. Sunshine Coast Airport is 15 km away.
The laid-back rooms feature free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, microwaves and minifridges, as well as tea and coffeemaking facilities. Family rooms offer extra bunk beds.
Parking is free. Other amenities include a common kitchen, a furnished terrace, and an outdoor pool with river views. There are also laundry facilities, and a private pontoon which can be used for private fishing and boat mooring.
